blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Pag-IBIG Fund saw a double-digit increase in sales from its Acquired Assets Program, raking in P25.23 billion from January to October as members turned to the agency’s affordable housing options. In a statement, Pag-IBIG said sales surged 74 percent to P25.23 billion in the 10 months, up from P14.53 billion in the same period last year. This translated to an average purchase price of about P1.4 million per property.
